messages:
nick: FYI kicked off a nightly recompute for NA aggregates, job id rb-0xb3. Saw a chunk of late events that would change totals for last 24h. Wondering if console should mark 'volatile window' for jobs touching recent partitions.

jo: what's the window size? how many partitions are affected?

nick: ~3 hours worth, ~120 shards out of 2.4k. replay-bot preflight flagged 'recent_write_overlap' on those shards.

replay-bot: job rb-0xb3 status: PREPARED
  affected_shards: 120
  total_shards: 2400
  recent_write_overlap: true

ana: product will flip if numbers jump. I think the console should show a volatility badge and a preview delta. Prefer default to postponing apply for 1 hour to let late writes settle.

jo: API change request: job_metadata.volatility_flag true/false + job_metadata.preview_delta_pct. Console teams can opt in.

nick: operational note: delaying 1 hour needs scheduler support; we can implement a 'delayed-apply' state for reprocess jobs. Also add max_delay=6h cap.

sre-oncall: also require that delayed-apply jobs are excluded from priority lanes unless operator approves. We don't want them eating burst capacity.

ana: UX: add a small yellow chip "volatile window" with tooltip: "recent writes may change output; preview available" and an action "delay apply 1h".

jo: will add preview endpoint: /v1/replays/{id}/preview which returns preview_delta_pct and sample rows. Also include a cost_estimate string.

nick: runbook snippet to delay apply:
```
# delay apply for job
replayctl delay --job rb-0xb3 --duration 1h --reason "volatile recent writes"
```

replay-bot: ledger event appended: 1768812352: delay applied (actor: nick)

ana: alerts: slack warn when volatility_flag=true and preview_delta_pct >= 0.5% for > 10m. Pager only if >=2% and manual-apply attempted.

sre-oncall: agree on thresholds. Also add metric tile "replay.volatility_pct" to staging dashboard.

jo: I'll wire the API change and preview route. Default job_metadata.volatility_flag = false; scheduler will set true if recent_write_overlap in preflight.

nick: decision: delay this job 1h, publish preview to PMs, then decide. Will monitor and escalate if late-writes continue.

ana: thanks. I'll draft a short note for #product and include preview link when available. :thumbsup:
